import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        return
    a = int(data[0])
    b = int(data[1])
    
    # Swap using arithmetic operations
    a = a + b
    b = a - b
    a = a - b
    
    print(f"{a} {b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
